Crafted in 100% cotton, these flat-front shorts are cool and casual, but with a crisp, clean finish—perfect for pairing with polos for weekend lunches or T-shirts for backyard barbecues. Heading for a hike? The variety of pockets and easy, relaxed fit have you covered. Only at Walmart.

TopReviews.ReviewText: Great fit, Very good quality. Can't beat the price.
Quality goods, low price. Fit was perfect after clicking on size guide.
I purchased the cargo shorts for my grandson and he loves them.  They are comfortable.
My husband loved them.

Title: Ben Hogan Men's and Big Men's Stretch 9" Golf Shorts with Active Waistband, Sizes 30-50
Description: These Ben Hogan Men's Stretch Flex 9" Golf Shorts with Active Waistband are enhanced with stretch for comfort and unrestricted movement on the course. Built for performance, these men's golf shorts also include moisture wicking for a dry feel and sun protection, so you can stay focused on your game and comfortable all day.

TopReviews.ReviewText: I wear these for work and I wear another version casually. For work I wear these in black. Working outside 90% of the time, these keep me cool and comfortable. If u do sweat these shorts dry very quickly. They stretch when bending down and stay in place thanks to some silicone on the waistband. I love these shorts and I own 10  pairs. My work shorts are on year  3 and still perfect. As long as these are available I will buy them!! Unbeatable shorts for $17.

high quality material used. seams are great.. 1 thing.. id highly recommend getting a size above what you wear.  if 32 get a 33... etc i had to go exchange what was delivered for a size up. other than that i love these shorts. there comfortable and can wear in dress or casual fit.

The ben hogan golf line is well made and affordable as Golf shirts  get so Soiled. After a couple of golf gameso, it's nice to be able to shop and pick up several shirts.Add an affordable price. And they look great.
I absolutely love these golf shorts they are very comfortable and the stretchable waistband really helps out I have bought several pairs of them and plan to buy more
True to size. Last forever, this is the second time we've bought them. The first time was about 5 or 6 years ago. Very comfortable.
Bought for my son to wear with his school uniform.  He said they are comfortable. He really likes them. Bought a few colors.
love these shorts. they wear like iron, dry quickly, aer comfotable. my go to golf shorts! i have recently lost some weight so restocked my wardrobe.

Since I have not used the product yet it is very unfair to be asked to rate the quality and my overall satisfaction.  In other words, your survey is invalid at this time, except for order and delivery questions.

Title: Wrangler Men's and Big Men's Outdoor Performance Side Elastic Waist Short (30-48)
Description: The Wrangler Men's Outdoor Performance Elastic Waist Shorts are made for comfort and function to get you through every day spent outdoors. Equipped with moisture-wicking properties, UPF 50 sun protection, secure zip pockets and a classic flex waistband. With this short you'll be ready to conquer the day ahead.

TopReviews.ReviewText: Husband needed shorts for work (works in a factory) so got him a black and a khaki colored pair. They fit well and look good-we said they look way better than the price and keeping them for work is kind of a shame; they could be worn for many other occasions.

The Wrangler shorts from Walmart are a definite win! I love them so much that I've collected every color available, though I wish there were even more to choose from. They're incredibly comfortable, easy to wash at home and hang dry without needing to iron, and the price is simply unbeatable.

I absolutely love men's shorts especially for hiking and other outdoorsy activities.  Why can't they make women's shorts with DEEP pockets and fabric that actually can withstand the outdoor elements.

I am totally a “girlie girl” however, when I'm hiking I like function over anything else and Walmart wrangler “MENS” pants/shorts are my go to

My bf loves these, he has 5 pairs now. He gets really hot but says these shorts are the coolest ones he's worn. Super comfortable with the stretch fabric. They can be dressed up - they don't wrinkle during wear. 
He's had 3 pairs for over a year and still look new. Did have a zip go on one pair, but he wears and washes these weekly year round.

These instantly became my favorite shorts.  I live in Arizona, so the lightweight fabric is really appreciated.  The fabric seems pretty durable so far.  The zipper is a little touchy.  It hasn't failed and maybe it won't, but it seems pretty sketchy.  For the price of these, I will buy more, zipper or not.

bought for husband that needed shorts to work in summer(woeks on cars), initially he thought they felt likeaterial of swim trunks but wore to work and said the felt really cool , stretchy amd comfortable,  $20 and change is a great price nowadays , il be buying more.

Love how these fit. I have back issues and can not wear a belt because it presses on one of my herniated discs. It has been difficult to find elastic waist short that stay up but don't press too hard on my disc. These fit perfectly. They are also nice and cool on the golf course when it's in the 90's. A few more colors would be nice, overall I'm very happy. Please!!! don't stop making these.
My boyfriend loves these shorts. He says they are very comfortable. I got him another pair for his birthday since he loved them so much

I purchased these for my husband and as soon as they came in and I opened the package I knew they were getting returned. Number one on my list of reasons was the material they are made out of. It's a big deal anymore to pay high prices for recycled materials. These are so thin I wouldn't wear them. I ended up taking them back to the store and finding a pair of Wrangler Cargo shorts that were a whole lot better quality for less and he loves them. I'm actually thinking about buying another pair a size smaller if I can find them.

The shorts 🩳 never arrived… trying to get Walmart Leadership to acknowledge the issue and get a refund or a replacement. Sadly the Team Member that I spoke with asked me to wait 48rs for FedEx to respond, however the issue is not FedEx related as it seems that it was the warehouse mistake for not checking the packing list. Clearly it was silly to think the carrier will be the one to blame. The search continues for a corporate %23 to get someone to sort out the confusion.

Title: GE CARGO SHORT
Description: GE MENS CARGO SHORT

TopReviews.ReviewText: I like these shorts. I wear a size 34 and the 34 George cargo shorts fit. I just sent back another brand that was way off sizing. I like the comfort and the snaps on the pockets. The only issue I have is, there is only one color left in my size and the price went up. Come on Walmart, get some more and put the price back where it was. You gained a customer for this item, don't blow it!!!

I searched several sites looking for what I wanted. Walmart had exactly what I was looking for at about 25% less, and free shipping! No driving, no gas expense, no hassle. Perfect. Arrived on time and exactly as advertised. Thanks…

These fit great and I have all three colors for everyday wear. The previous pair are still in use, too, but with some spots I caused and they are used when I work around the house. No issues whatsoever after two years of wear.  I order the 34 inch size, but my waist actually measures 36 inch, and they fit perfect.

Can't beat the quality for the price! Super soft, wash up nicely (I do steam the pockets bc we don't like wrinkles). Bought 1 pair bc they seemed too good to be true. They are fantastic so I purchased 5 more pairs. My husbands new fav shorts!
I rated the product good but not the delivery. The delivery date was one day off, but the problem was the delivery instructions where not followed by the shipping company.
My husband was very pleased with the fit %26 comfort of these shorts. I purchased 3 different colors/patterns of the George brand, %26 each pair exceeded our expectations.

All cotton cant be beat.  Although cotton is prone to shrink after washing....it also stretches with wear.  Cotton is more comfortable and this price at under $10 is fabulous.  
The stitching is clean and straight.  Button hole is durable and fits the button.  I bought two at first....now I'm going back in for different colors, same size.

Love the pants my husband's favorite style. Only problem was they were dropped off my a person who was smoking marijuana the package and the pants smelled HORRIBLE!! I don't think random people should be driving for Walmart if they are delivering packages in this condition. GROSS!
I got 3 pants from the George brand, all of them the same size and the same style fit. Only one of them fits me, all of them are different sizes. The pair that does fit got a hole in it quickly.

Can't give a review, because I never received these shorts. Instead, they delivered a totally different style with a string on the side. There is no way my husband would even think of wearing those tried to return them could not do that, because totally different number than what's on my account. very upset and disappointed so now we have a pair of shorts that no one will wear

Title: Mens 5-Pockets Flex Stretch Cotton Chino Shorts (3-Pack)
Description: 5-Pack Mens 5-Pocket Flat-Front Chino Shorts with Flat-Front Design & Slim-Fit Design. Stretch Cotton Fabric For Versatility & Comfort, Button Closure W/ Functional Fly Zipper 2-Side Pockets, 2-Back Pockets, 1-Coin Pocket, Belt Loops Double Stitched Hem. TopReviews.ReviewText: The fabric is very stretchy and comfortable, fit is excellent. The craftmanship, (seams, beltloops), is excellent, pockets are a good depth. You cannot go wrong if you want a high quality product at a great price, I'm glad I purchased 6 pairs of these.
Husband loved them, he said they were very comfortable. You can dress them up  for a casual look or dress down with a T-shirt. True to size. Quality is great as well

I was worried because it was a great price, that the quality wouldn't be there. Or the size would be off. However, to my delight, they were perfect.  He tried them on and they were great. Washed and dried them, no change.

While they turned out to be a heavier material than expected or hoped (I was looking for the lightest material I could find for hot-summer wear) this is definitely a good value for a 3-pack of well-made shorts. More suitable for spring or fall than the heat of summer here in California, but, again, a good buy if you're looking for shorts for moderately warm days, or cooler temperatures.
Dare i say Excellent product again!!  If these were junk shorts they'd been returned.  Had to order MORE!
i double ordered this item.  How do I return it?

Bought this three pack for my son because I wasn't wanting to pay $25 for a pair of shorts. These work out to roughly $10-$12 apiece. But beware these are not even worth the money. They are thin, full of loose threads, and a rough zipper. Just made cheap. I would not buy them again. Also, they're not even close to being as long as what this picture shows. I will probably keep them just to avoid the hassle so that he will have these to wear until I can get other ones. Would not recommend.
Overall the fit was larger than the size stated in the ad and on the clothes tag.  The material had a good feel to it.  The price was a good value.

I re-ordered this 3-pack of shorts because of a good experience with the first order, but this new 3-pack came with an entirely different label name than the "Galaxy by Harvic" label promised in the item description (and received in the first order I liked), and sizing between the 3 pair of shorts were all over the place this time, both too big and too small. Disappointing, because I would've ordered these often if they were like the first 3-pack of Galaxy shorts I got.

Really loved theses shorts but they just are not good enough quality. The seam in the buttocks is single stitch and not the best quality meaning they will survive a few washes before it falls apart. All 6 of the shorts I purchased are coming apart at that seam after the first wash. 😣

Title: George Men's Messenger Short
Description: Jump right into this supremely comfortable longer length cargo shorts. These shorts are an easy pick for lounging around the house or a spontaneous adventure. This short features a comfort flex elastic waistband and a longer inseam so the bottom will hit you below the knee. The durable and stretchy fabric assures mobility while multiple pockets keep necessities organized. The strong and breathable cotton is infused with spandex to make these shorts supremely comfortable.

TopReviews.ReviewText: The George Men's and Big Men's Messenger Cargo Shorts, in camo print, are his absolute favorite pair of shorts! He loves the extra long length, and he says they are really comfortable. I wish that there were more colors/prints to choose from, in that same length.

I like the way these fit particularly in the waste, during Covid lockdown I gained a few pounds of belly fat and the waste band on these shorts helps with that without having to get a bigger size.  Thank you Walmart for a great deal and fast shipping.

I like these a lot they're one of my favorite they're nice and long and cover my knees but they are kind of thin and only have like 5 belt loops I think 7 would be better. I like the leg ties to they look cool 😎

I have ordered well over two dozen of these for my husband. He is 6'2 and they come just below the knee. The waistline has a soft cotton stretchy band. Perfect for expansion through the day. True to size. Perfect for taller people.

Second time around getting these, and they changed from the first time a year ago, fortunately for the better, so I am pleased. better Button, and material feels thicker/more tpi it seems, which will only help them last longer. Good Short for people wanting over the knee type.

My husband loves these.. he is 6'5, 280 and usually a size 2XT. This is his second pair, the last pair he has had for over three years and they ripped across next to the back left pocket toward the right pocket probably from wear and tear.  As a tall man he loves the length and the flex. He was concerned that these new ones don't say FLEX on the inside elastic like the older one do but he likes them just as much. He has bought them in several colors. My faborite are the classic khaki look.  42x32 fits true to size. Lightweight, perfect for SC heat.

I has been looking for below the knee shorts and had been unable to find them elsewhere. I purchase two pair in the store and purchased two pair on line because the ones I ordered on line were not available in the colors and size that I needed. I now have four pair in four different colors.

I used to like these shorts more! This is the third time I have bought them. But, these latest ones have the cell phone pocket on the back of the left leg. I'm right handed, majority of people are! Why did they change?!? My previous ones had the cell phone pocket on the right leg!

I bought 1 pair. I liked them so much I went back %26 bought 2 more. Different colors of course. They just have 4 colors to pick from. I'd like blue/navy, light grey,  desert camo, maybe  stripes or plaid options to be added. I like that they're longer, above the knee, %26 not the traditional shorter shorts. I love all the pockets! I just wish there were more color/pattern options. Price is ok. They're very comfortable %26 fit true to size for me as a 32.

doesnt matter if you do the washing instructions down to the T the collor fades on these. its a bummer because they fit nicely and look great the first time you wear them. i work outside and bought a few pairs of these. the first day it rained and when i got home i noticed they looked orange in a lot of places. i washed them with like colors according to instructions and when they came out of the dryer it was 9bvious that the color washed out all over the place. made them look 20 years old. bummer

Title: Wrangler Men's and Big Men's Stretch Cargo Shorts
Description: Weekends were made for these Wrangler Men's & Big Men's Cargo Shorts. Made in a Relaxed Fit and epic soft fabric that flexes with you, these cargos redefine comfort. With side cargo pockets, slash pockets in front, back welt pockets, and a tech pocket for your cell, there is ample room for necessities on the go. Style comes easy whether you’re enjoying down-time or busy from sun-up to sunset.

TopReviews.ReviewText:
The manly man of mine wears these with his company shirts to work. In fact, they are the only brand he'll wear because... and I quote," They are made well. They are comfortable and I don't have to worry about them splitting!"
I like them because I've washed his other pairs of these same shorts every day for 4 months and they still look great considering what he walks in the door looking like! He's lost weight and that's the only reason we have to replace them! I totally recommend this brand and style of men's shorts!

very comfortable.goes right to bottom of knee.light weight durable material if you wear a 34 and order a 34 there going to be a lil baggy.i am about a 35 and 34 was loose but not falling off.i have a pair in another color.that i have had and i love this particular pair. its hard to find shorts that go to the knee anymore.all this fruity fairies running around showing there legs.aint nobody wanting to see some dudes legs.these are perfect if your a real man.lol

I like these so much I've purchased several pair. The price is reasonable, the fit is reliably good, and the pockets are great. You can carry keys, a cell phone, and whatever will fit (which can be surprisingly large, such as a beverage can or few cans of cat food) in the various pockets. The hook and loop fasteners will keep your cell phone from falling out. Highly recommend.

I hope Walmart doesn't stop carrying these. They're my favorite shorts. I buy one or two pairs a year and they hold up well. After many many uses they start to give out as expected for something you wear a ton. They run true to size, are comfortable, and the price is very affordable.

I like the wrangler shorts for the last 5 years. I prefer them over similar brands because they are well made with good cotton material, and the cell phone slot is convenient so you don't need to reach inside a pocket for the phone. They are true to size and fit well

Love the shorts. Soft, fit great, and a quality feel. I alway wash them with lights, and now they have a dull yellowish hue after just a few months. Hopefully I can wash that out, but its difficult washing garments with a white foundation, and color patterns on top.

Great shorts but I drive for a living in the sun that goes through the window fades half the shorts within four months… Referring to the black pair so below the pocket it's tan and your backside and above the pocket is black kind of looks weird after a while

The website has two prominent images of these shorts which, even close up, appear to be a true denim fabric texture.  The shorts I received do not look anything like that.  They do not have a denim texture.  They have that thin, synthetic look with horizontal lines throughout.  They are very, very thin.  The website does not indicate the fabric weight in ounces.  That is because they don't want you to know the true thin, fabric weight.  In my opinion, they are awful. Poor website image representation and description.  And, Wrangler is as American a product name as they come.  Well, mine were made in Bangladesh.  I should have been suspicious because of the low price.  All the big name, long-standing sportswear companies have cheaped down their products.  Very upset with the deception.

We ended up returning this one I believe because of the size. It was too big for my husband. Other than that for the price, these shorts are great. I bought these for my husband for several years now. The only thing I didn't notice that maybe there's a thinner fabric that can rip easily, but I know things have gone up and the price of these has not changed. I'm sure they've had to cut back on material.

I like the shorts, what i don't like is Walmart's inventory management practices.  I bought 4 pairs of shorts, was told they were in stock and given a delivery date.   Only one pair arrived and an email delivered that they don't have the balance to ship, yet.   Not sure how long I am supposed to wait.  If something is "in stock" and if I am given a delivery date when ordering, then I should get the products I purchased.  No different than an airline overbooking flights.  Don't sell something you don't have!!

Title: Ma Croix Men's Mesh Shorts With Pockets Gym Basketball Activewear

Title: Lee Men's Extreme Motion Athletic Jean
Description:
Lee Men's Extreme Motion Athletic Jean

For the guy on the go, look no further than the Lee Men’s Extreme Motion Athletic Jean. Created with comfort, durability and flexibility in mind, this classic 5-pocket style features a performance stretch fabric and Extreme Flex waistband, so it moves with you for all day comfort. The inseam gusset paired with a roomier fit through the seat and thigh allow more flexibility for the athletically built guy. A tapered leg and fitted waist give this jean a contemporary silhouette.

The history of denim is woven into the Lee brand. As one of the original American denim companies, Lee has been crafting purposeful designs for more than 130 years. Founded in 1889, Lee’s heritage is filled with fashion firsts marked by innovative fits, era-defining silhouettes, and legendary details. Whether outfitting cowboys, factory workers, or movie stars, Lee’s timeless style has always been made for the many, not the few. Today, Lee’s commitment to authenticity, fit and quality along with its famous pioneering spirit and unrelenting optimism have created generations of brand loyalists across the globe.

Title: Lee Men's Extreme Motion Athletic Jean
Description:
Lee Men's Extreme Motion Athletic Jean

For the guy on the go, look no further than the Lee Men’s Extreme Motion Athletic Jean. Created with comfort, durability and flexibility in mind, this classic 5-pocket style features a performance stretch fabric and Extreme Flex waistband, so it moves with you for all day comfort. The inseam gusset paired with a roomier fit through the seat and thigh allow more flexibility for the athletically built guy. A tapered leg and fitted waist give this jean a contemporary silhouette.

The history of denim is woven into the Lee brand. As one of the original American denim companies, Lee has been crafting purposeful designs for more than 130 years. Founded in 1889, Lee’s heritage is filled with fashion firsts marked by innovative fits, era-defining silhouettes, and legendary details. Whether outfitting cowboys, factory workers, or movie stars, Lee’s timeless style has always been made for the many, not the few. Today, Lee’s commitment to authenticity, fit and quality along with its famous pioneering spirit and unrelenting optimism have created generations of brand loyalists across the globe.

Title: Lee Men's Extreme Motion Athletic Jean

The history of denim is woven into the Lee brand. As one of the original American denim companies, Lee has been crafting purposeful designs for more than 130 years. Title: Reebok Men's and Big Men's Anchor Five Pocket Pants, Size 28-48
Description: Reebok Men's “Anchor” Pant is perfect for active days or everyday casual wear with five pockets for a stylish look on the go. TopReviews.ReviewText:
I recently picked up a pair of Reebok Men's Anchor Five-Pocket Pants, and I've been pleasantly surprised by their comfort and versatility. Here's what I think after wearing them for a while.

The Good:

Relaxed Fit with Stretch: These pants are perfect for lounging or running errands. The relaxed fit gives you plenty of room to move, and the polyester material with a touch of stretch makes them super comfortable to wear all day long.
Five Pockets for Convenience: The classic five-pocket design is perfect for everyday wear. There's enough space for your phone, wallet, and keys without feeling bulky.
Stylish Look: Even though they're comfortable, these pants still look polished. The tapered leg and invisible side zipper give them a clean, modern look that can be dressed up or down. They come in various colors, too, so you can find a pair that suits your style.
Affordable Price: I found these pants at Walmart for around $28, a great price for a comfortable and stylish pair of everyday pants.
Not So Great:

Material Might Not Be for Everyone: The pants are made of 100% polyester, which some people might find too warm or not breathable enough for hot weather.
Limited to Casual Wear: While they look nice, these aren't dress pants. The material and style are best suited for casual wear and lounging.
Overall:

If you're looking for a comfortable and stylish pair of pants for everyday wear, the Reebok Men's Anchor Five Pocket Pants are a great option. They're affordable, well-made, and come in a variety of colors.  Remember that the material might not be ideal for everyone, and they are best suited for casual occasions.

Title: Lee Women's Mid-Rise Bootcut Jean
Description:
Lee Women's Mid-Rise Bootcut Jean

Our women’s mid-rise bootcut is one of our most popular jeans for a reason. We combined a premium cotton blend made of recycled fibers and just a hint of stretch to create a fabric that feels great, flatters your curves, and keeps you comfortable all day long. This stylish jean sits right at the natural waist and features a regular fit through the seat and thigh. With all the legendary details that have made Lee® an original, such as our curve-contouring spade pockets and branded back patch, this jean will give you the confidence to tackle whatever the day may have in store. With a variety of washes to choose from, you can easily make this mid-rise bootcut jean a permanent staple in your casual wardrobe. The history of denim is woven into the Lee® brand. As one of the original American denim companies, Lee has been crafting purposeful designs for more than 130 years. Founded in 1889, Lee’s heritage is filled with fashion firsts marked by innovative fits, era-defining silhouettes, and legendary details. Whether outfitting cowboys, factory workers, or movie stars, Lee’s timeless style has always been made for the many, not the few. Today, Lee’s commitment to authenticity, fit and quality along with its famous pioneering spirit and unrelenting optimism have created generations of brand loyalists across the globe.

TopReviews.ReviewText:
This is a correction to my previous review. The gathers CAN be adjusted. I thought the side strings were stitched in place and I was wrong. Its a simple half knot that is easily wriggled out of the casing and untied to make the strings perfectly and easily adjustable for a custom fit. I actually sat down in bright daylight with my reading glasses on and my seam ripper in hand. Imagine my surprise (and chagrin) to discover, upon closer inspection, that there are no stay stiches on the gathering strings. Just a simple half knot, easy to untie. 

With this discovery, I like the dresses even more. At this price they are an absolute bargain!

I'm wearing these dresses as pinafores or jumpers. They look good with both short sleeve and long sleeve tops underneath. The fit is good. I'm 220 pounds, and 5ft 3. The XXXL fits me a little loosely but is comfortable and attractive. The XXL looks beautiful--very slimming, but feels a bit snug through the waist. 

The double gathers in the front and back are stitched down. They cannot be loosened or tightened for a custom fit unless you carefully use a seam ripper to remove the few stiches that anchor each string in place. With that caveat, the idea of the double gathers is clever and they wind up being especially flattering on my pear shaped figure.

The fabric, Lyocel, is new to me. It feels like rayon, cool, drapey, breathable. Like rayon, these dresses shrink a teeny tiny bit with washing and drying. I've read that Lyocel is a new sustainable "Green" fabric, made from wood pulp. It feels good on my skin, very much like a natural fabric. 

I have been wearing these pinafores with black Mary Jane shoes, t-shirts and cropped cardigans. It's an adult version of the School Girl look. Very cute. The blue one looks like faded tencel denim.

Lastly, pockets. Can I just say how happy I am that Walmart is now including pockets in most of their dresses?! I'm hoping Walmart makes more sleeveless dresses that work over t-shirts. It makes getting dressed in the morning so easy!!!

TopReviews.ReviewText: I lived in Walmart's Jordache jeans back in the early 2000's. Maybe they were juniors sizing since I wore a 7/8 short. Or maybe they didn't even need to be hemmed or purchased in a short because sizing was different then. Anyway, they were my ride and die jeans for the next 10-15 years. They eventually wore out or maybe I got tired of them but I still look every time I go to Walmart. Well the other night I spied these girl's Jordache jeans and grabbed two pairs of the bootcut style in size 18 and now I'm back in my Jordache jeans. The only caveat is that only two of the available washes/rinses fit (the medium dark or something along those lines) as for example the light color was too tight. I also think they're a little long but not long enough to tailor. For reference, I am 5'2”, around 130 lbs., and have short legs. I'm also 44 so definitely have some hips and booty which these jeans definitely flatter. If any other petite ladies are out there lamenting the loss of their Jordache jeans, perhaps give these a go. I've washed them twice now and no color fade; a few minutes in the dryer on medium heat and they look great.
